description.en: The Xiaomi MiMo desktop app's own account channel: log in with the Xiaomi account (SSO passToken) and chat with the free-tier MiMo X models on the desktop gateway, with cycle usage and the live model catalog.
description.zh: 小米 MiMo 桌面 App 自带账号通道：用小米账号（SSO passToken）登录，即可在桌面网关上使用免费档 MiMo X 模型，附带周期额度与实时模型目录。

description.en: Paste the account.xiaomi.com cookie block (passToken, userId, cUserId — DevTools → Application → Cookies after signing into the Xiaomi account in the MiMo app or on account.xiaomi.com). The plugin replays the desktop app's SSO chain itself to mint the api session and renews it every 12 hours, so MiMo X chat, usage and the model catalog stay live for the passToken's ~30-day life.
description.zh: 粘贴 account.xiaomi.com 的 Cookie（passToken、userId、cUserId —— 在 MiMo App 或 account.xiaomi.com 登录小米账号后从开发者工具 → Application → Cookies 复制）。插件会自行重放桌面 App 的 SSO 链铸造 api 会话并每 12 小时自动续期，在 passToken 约 30 天的有效期内 MiMo X 聊天、额度与模型目录持续可用。

help_text.en: Cookie block for account.xiaomi.com. The passToken lives ~30 days; with it the plugin mints the MiMo X session itself.
help_text.zh: account.xiaomi.com 域的 Cookie。passToken 约 30 天有效，插件用它自行铸造 MiMo X 会话。

help_text.en: Optional. Cookie block for mimo-server-cn.xiaomimimo.com if you already have one (DevTools on a logged-in MiMo app). Skip it and the plugin mints the session from the account cookie.
help_text.zh: 可选。若已有 mimo-server-cn.xiaomimimo.com 的 Cookie（在已登录的 MiMo App 开发者工具中复制）可直接填入；不填则插件用账号 Cookie 自动铸造。
